comparison.objective: Hold open a spring-loaded flange joint, insert and center a blind plate, then ease the joint closed; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Sustained gap holding plus plate insertion differs from hex-key alignment, fastener release, fine collar rotation, and torque-limited relocking.
comparison.success_condition: Plate must clear the gap, center on a mark, and remain gripped; candidate requires repeated safe impact stops and adjustment retention. Centering and seating tolerances are missing.
comparison.reason: This tests insertion under spring load, not dynamic damper adjustment.
